## Checklist

- [ ] Based on the latest `main`, and does one thing

- [ ] Code, comments and docs are in English; if one README changed, the other was updated to match
- [ ] All UI text is in the locale files, in both Chinese and English
- [ ] No Google services or public CDNs; any new dependency works in mainland China

- [ ] No passwords, keys or tokens committed
